pin.scope: OpenXR 1.1.65 specification pose/frame facts and pinned XrQuaternionf/XrPosef header ABI; no OpenXR runtime is configured and no xr* function is called

specification_facts_reviewed: XrQuaternionf is a unit quaternion with float x, y, z, w members.
XrPosef stores orientation and position; position is in meters and orientation is applied before translation.
xrLocateSpace returns the pose of space in baseSpace at the requested time; results may change as reference-space origins are revised.
VIEW, LOCAL, and LOCAL_FLOOR use +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; STAGE uses +Y up with runtime-defined XZ bounds and optional support.
review.frame_direction_interpretation: Reading the returned pose as a baseSpace-from-space point mapping follows the pose definition; this is a specification interpretation, not a native runtime observation.
limitations: No OpenXR runtime was installed or registered in the capture environment; no xr* function was called.
Runtime pose location, tracking validity, and runtime-specific space relations are not native observations.
OpenXR does not define a universal world frame.
